The Norton - a stylised, bolder, version of the classic Wayfarer. This special edition is hand-customised for us in BOLD's East London workshop, featuring a BOLD x Iron Heart engraving on the inner right arm.
BOLD London is a boutique eyewear brand born from a passion for crafting exquisite, impeccably constructed frames using the finest materials and time-honoured British artisanal techniques. Each pair is meticulously sculpted by hand from premium cellulose acetate. First, the raw shape is cut from a block, then filed into shape before heat is applied to manipulate the curvature. The frames are then buffed and polished by hand before undergoing an intensive tumbling process—for up to 48 hours—to achieve a flawlessly smooth, even finish.
Built for durability and distinction, one of BOLD’s signature design elements is the extra thickness in the front and sides of the frame, enhancing strength while remaining lightweight. This model is constructed using robust 7-barrel rivet hinges and fitted with Carl Zeiss dark grey lenses, offering style and superior optical performance.

Our modern slim cut jean made from our brand new 14oz broken twill selvedge denim. Broken twill denim was first used in 1964 by Wrangler as a solution for combatting leg twist. The process of weaving fabric in this method sees the combination of both right hand twill (RHT) and left hand twill (LHT) reversed every two warp ends, forming a zigzag-like pattern in the denim and leaving no bias in either direction of the weave, therefore eliminating leg twist.
